title: Planning puts every reader of a symbol a goal changes into the item's touches, so workers do not stop or widen touches themselves
goal: SP-befc6yqr: ST-qgnjxiol stopped on the backlog.py registration and bl_land/bl_cli readers outside its touches (a resume round trip), and BG-uoexdu6y's worker widened its own touches by six bl_ modules that import the constants it changed. Planning (kb-sprint plan step 2, /kb-backlog bug) runs backlog.py referrers on each symbol or constant an item's goal changes and on a new subcommand's facade registration, and adds the files it lists to touches before the claim.
notes: Merged from ST-yjq7extd “An item that moves benchmark figures has README.md in its touches, since report --check reads README's numbers” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: map.csv has no bench_report.py or benchmarks.csv row and bl_check.py never reads map.csv, so the goal needs new code for one occurrence; a one-clause planning touches rule instead. Its goal: kb/_self/map.csv (or the planning check that reads it) maps _tools/bench_report.py and kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv to README.md, so backlog.py check warns when an item that touches the results file or the report code lacks README.md in its touches; SP-x7ger6vu: ST-qiep6y7i's re-record replaced figures README.md:54 names, report --check failed on them, and README was added to the touches mid-run (accepted at the SP-x7ger6vu close) Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/selfdoc.py", "check"]} Its touches: kb/_self/map.csv, _tools/bl_check.py, kb/_self/backlog.md Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 11 of 13, "Planning rules 1: checks that run behaviour, touches that hold every reader"); it blocks no fitness test and no real user reported it, so it sits in a late sprint of the sequence.
